checks.scope: Actual bounded pointer queue; not task execution ownership or exhaustive weak-memory proof.
Historical lifecycle CAS helper plus separate ownership reference/counterexample model; current runtime custody is tested by task_ownership.
Source pattern/order checks for preserved current owner; not runtime liveness.
Source guard for saved-frame offset; runtime rows require a supplied boot log.
Source guards for user-pointer validation; not an authority or hostile-code proof.
Full-width capability and destination identity decoding; not memory authority or reply authentication.
Production registry identity validation; not capability graph immutability.
By-value fault request validation; not mapping, completion or recovery.
Startup-only authenticated readiness protocol; not epoch/UiIR replay.
Extracted production bitmap reconstruction/allocation with fixture I/O; not device persistence or whole-disk crash proof.
Actual boot-only readiness protocol with syscall boundary doubles and three source wiring checks; not restart availability or epoch replay.
Production atomic custody plus bounded queue; finite traces and host races do not prove x86 stack release or physical AP scheduling.
Production region authorization, exact extracted syscall query, bounded DMA leases and PCI bounds; not hardware DMA or hostile-code containment.
Actual extracted USB/NIC reservation helpers within boot budgets; mock view lookup, no hardware DMA.
Production storage DMA transfer guard: abort before submission, completion and timeout quarantine; not hardware completion proof.
Production bounded ELF byte allocator: initialization, alignment, allocation/free reuse, exhaustion and concurrent access; no new frame authority or demand paging.
Production pending identity, nonwrapping tokens and fault-specific custody; host scheduling does not execute IRET.
Production capability validation/ledger and leaf commit with mocked fault/TLB boundary; no guest instruction retry.
Actual ring-3 allocator/policy/protocol with mock backend, including quota and uncertain publication custody.
Optimized production compiler-runtime memcpy/memset bodies plus guard/zero-size/repeated-copy execution; optional post-build ELF self-recursion inspection.
Actual sext policy and allocator under duplicate/stale release requests, uncertain reclamation, cross-client reuse and correlated acknowledgments; backend doubles do not prove PTE/TLB execution.

Actual reply router captures current PD identity, retains occupied slots, and wakes only after publication; listen register tuple is checked statically. This does not prove return-capability or outstanding-invocation authority.
Production bounded exit watch with actual task ownership, last-runnable wake, full-ring retry, exact task and trampoline quiescence; no physical stack or TLB execution.
Extracted actual Linen snapshot/receiver functions with mock PDX/HID: foreign reply rejection, complete publication, failed-view preservation and selection changes during fetch.

Actual immutable lifecycle/activation grants, dormant/terminal routing, leaf preflight, retirement, one-shot activation and exhaustion with explicit registry/mapper/scheduler/TLB mocks; BSP guest remains required.

Actual service retirement and RamFs owner-private atomic history replacement, bounded client/service receipt state machines, malformed/cross-subject/replay/backpressure cases with mocked PDX transport, authority and host locks. Guest persistence remains separate.
Actual display catalog/owner admission and retirement state; not rendered frame timing.
Actual shell app retirement, interaction cleanup and ACK retry; transport/display mocked.
Actual full-pool scrub and rotating journal in real host memory; kernel retirement authority separate.
Actual Bell retirement preserves live queue order, identities, policies and rate state.
Exact production integer glyph scaling, clipping and width-aware reflow in a host framebuffer; real desktop screenshots remain required.
Actual app call/receive serialization with mocked register transport, enqueue failures and authenticated cooperative close.
Actual bounded retained shell response and normal producer wiring; no transactional reply capability proof.
Actual bounded Linen labels and shell child geometry publication with mock display transport; real guest glyph verification remains separate.
Actual compositor pixels and fixed catalog grouping with glass effects stubbed; guest framebuffer verification remains necessary.
Actual bounded text outbox with injected full transport and production poll wiring; admission receipts are not framebuffer presentation.
Exact existing-incarnation lookup and bounded launcher text; Quil successor resolution is separately covered by app_activation.

Actual shell successor resolution with mocked register transport; static BOOT/runtime commit wiring. Actual kernel transitions and adversarial preflight run in app_resources; guest activation and glyphs remain separate.

profile.scope: Bounded sampled guest-tick observations, not host seconds; all structural/focus redraws retained until512, every16th ordinary text draw sampled; clock-only strips excluded. Fitted-noop totals sum observations and may repeat across different draws in one drain; they are not unique operation counts.
